text:
maya: opening a tracking thread — two customer subs need GPU quota & reservation work. subs: `sub-8452` (eastus2) needs ND40rs x12, `sub-9001` (francecentral) needs NC24 x8. Also need vnet port/nic quota increase. cc @raj
raj: on it. creating the azure support case now. any hard dates?
sophie: target regions noted. prefer reserving ND40rs in eastus2 and NC24 in francecentral. we should request NIC and IP quota bump too (we hit limits last month). cost heads-up: monthly reserved commit estimate ~ $18k for eastus2 pool.
infra-bot: created internal tracker INFRA-4821 and assigned to eng-infra.
raj: Azure case created -> 2109876543. pinged TAM and asked for both quota + capacity reservation. added link to azure docs: https://aka.ms/az-reserve-gpu
maya: adding context: last time we also hit subnet port limits (route table + NSG entries) — include request for vnet service endpoint and subnet /24 -> /22 expansion in the ticket.
raj: can you paste the vnet/subnet details so I include exact CIDR?
maya: vnet: 10.10.0.0/16, gpu-subnet: 10.10.4.0/24 -> plan to move to 10.10.0.0/22 to give more IP space.
sophie: Azure will ask for expected sustained vCPU and throughput per cluster. FYI our perf targets: ~8k tokens/s per ND40rs node for typical gen workload, model load ~10s. attaching perf snippets in tracker.
maya: owners: raj -> azure comms/escalation, sophie -> sizing + perf numbers, maya -> cost approval + finance gating.
raj: Azure support replied: case escalated to subscription team, they requested subscription owner email verification + compliance checklist. ETA they gave: 5-7 business days for quota validation, capacity reservation may take longer depending on region.
az-support: Support(az): Case 2109876543 updated — ND40rs quota increase validated pending capacity reservation approval. Please confirm subscription owner email & a point of contact for compliance.
maya: confirmed owner email (ops+gpu@redwood.ai) and added to the case thread. tracker INFRA-4821 updated with azure case link and notes.
sophie: once capacity reservation is confirmed i'll schedule smoke tests (test plan: model load, grpc handshake, 1k token burst, model inference latency < 150ms median).
raj: added fallback plan: if eastus2 ND40rs capacity not available by next Mon, we’ll reroute to westeurope NCv3 pool and kick off quicker onboarding there. also requesting billing pre-approve monthly commit so TAM can proceed.
az-support: Support(az): updated — subscription verification received. Escalation in progress. Will update when reservation window is confirmed.
maya: thanks — i'll follow up with finance for the commit approval. if anything blocks, mention INFRA-4821. :raised_hands:
raj: i'll follow up with TAM tomorrow 09:00 PDT and post updates here. marking last_message_ts.
